title: picker ghost text placeholder
name: Picker ghost text placeholder — Spectrum
rule: Picker placeholder ("ghost text") is allowed — prompts selection and disappears once a value is chosen. CONFLICT with Spectrum text-field "don't use placeholder" and NN/g placeholders. Dual-cite; picker-only. Do not pick a winner.
pass_when: A picker may show ghost-text that disappears after a value is chosen, and text fields still have a visible label (in-field hint extra, never only label).
fail_when: A text field uses disappearing placeholder as the only label; or picker ghost-text is treated as a pass for text fields.
overview: Picker ghost text may prompt selection; text fields still need a lasting visible label.
apply_when: Spectrum pickers that prompt an unset choice with temporary ghost text.
not_when: Text fields using disappearing placeholder as the only label.
agent_hint: Allow picker ghost text only; keep a visible lasting label on text fields.
description: Spectrum pickers may show ghost-text placeholders that prompt selection and disappear once a value is chosen. That picker-only allowance conflicts with Spectrum text-field and NN/g guidance against placeholder-as-label, so do not treat picker ghost text as a pass for text inputs. Text fields still need a lasting visible label; an in-field hint is extra, never the only name. Dual-cite both sources and keep the split by control type rather than picking a house winner.
do_not_claim: A winner that bans picker ghost-text or legalizes placeholder-as-only-label on text fields. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.field_labels.visible_label` / `forms.field_labels.placeholder_hint_conflict`. Extra 73 skipped Polar/Fluent placeholder-as-hint.
